WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bw
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
),
station_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg_bw
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT 
  AVG(station_avg_bw) as mean_bandwidth_usage,
  AVG(station_avg_bw) - (SELECT avg_bw FROM overall_avg) as above_average
FROM station_avgs
CROSS JOIN overall_avg
WHERE station_avg_bw > (SELECT avg_bw FROM overall_avg)
